# Testing That a File-Backed mmap Isn't Repeatedly Remapped

The concern is that code might call `mmap()` over and over (e.g., per-access or per-read) instead of mapping once. Here are several ways
message.reasoning: Question: how to test that a file-backed mmap isn't repeatedly remapped (i.e., mapping established once, not re-mapping on each access). Provide approaches: strace counting mmap calls, /proc/self/maps snapshots, page fault counters (/proc/pid/stat minor/major faults), perf stat, smaps, breakpoint on mmap via LD_PRELOAD, kernel tracepoints.
